title: Exact coefficient change does not alter affine etale sections under sheafification
statement: Let S be a scheme, A a category and B a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Let F be an A-valued sheaf on the small etale site of S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], L:A -> B a functor preserving finite limits, and V an etale S-scheme whose domain is affine [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Then the sheafification unit F(V) mapped by L -> a(F composed with L)(V) is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0738(4), finite matching argument; the affine basis comparison of Topologies Tag 04HR.

proof.text: Restrict to the full affine etale site. Its topology is generated by finite covers and it has pullbacks. Express the sheaf condition by the finite saturated matching multifork. Multifork.isLimitMapOfPreserves transports its limit through L, including the empty cover.

The full affine inclusion is one-hypercover-dense and a dense subsite. Apply its isIso_whiskerLeft_toSheafify theorem to the sheaf just obtained. Evaluate the resulting natural isomorphism at the specified affine etale object V.
